review_kind: independent static source review of adapters written by another agent

simulation_evidence_reviewed.tool: Model Technology ModelSim SE-64 vsim 2020.4 Simulator 2020.10 Oct 13 2020
additional_fault_evidence: one actual native E opcode14 injection: no residual/output write and next frame recovery
one actual native G fn4 beat among four pairs: all4 issued/retired, no mid/output write, next frame recovery
E/G service response stalled after real destination ACK
coordinated reset while G response retained after destination write
uncovered_standalone: G odd count, ungated and fn1/2/3, all unsupportedfn variants
independent native input/output stalls and all adapter reset phases

checks.static_result: request opcode/function, count, addresses and flags are captured only on req_valid && req_ready; no live host field used after acceptance
checks.required_simulation: mutate source request fields after handshake and verify unchanged operation

checks.static_result: A+B for 0/1/2/4/5/9, A+B+C for 3/6, A-only for 7/8/10/11/12/13; invalid14/15 also gathers only A before native error
checks.required_simulation: per-op read count and full operand mask including FMA and RoPE

checks.static_result: count1..4 selects complete S32 words at input; result selects count S16 values, zeroes unused low64 lanes and high64; count>4 rejected
checks.required_simulation: positive/negative S32, RNE ties, saturation, count1/4 and rejected5

checks.static_result: input count is S16 elements, output compact S8 at bits8*n with every remaining bit zero
checks.required_simulation: count1/8, signed values and high64 zero

checks.static_result: count0 or >8 rejects locally; RoPE9 requires even count; zero-initialize unused operands/input lanes and mask result tail
checks.required_simulation: count0/9, odd RoPE, dirty inactive lanes

checks.static_result: consume/capture each read response before issuing next; ISSUE waits native in handshake; CAPTURE waits actual out handshake; native error goes to RESPONSE without destination write
checks.required_simulation: read, native input/output stalls; native14/15 error with zero result-write count

checks.static_result: count1..8 => total_pairs ceil(count/2) <=4; issued advances only native input accept; retired advances only native output accept; retired<issued prevents consuming unissued output
checks.required_simulation: native backpressure and issued/retired conservation over count1/3/8

checks.static_result: unused A/gate lanes zero before issue, ungated mode never reads B, only declared count lanes captured; odd dummy output discarded and result tail remains zero
checks.required_simulation: odd count with dirty source tails, gated and ungated functions

checks.static_result: last output updates result_hold by NBA while moving to WRITE_REQ; first possible write handshake is next edge, after final data capture; last retired implies all total_pairs issued
checks.required_simulation: distinct last pair data, immediate mem_req_ready and destination writeback literal check

checks.static_result: fn4..7 is not locally remapped; all pair input/output transactions drain; OR includes previous errors and current last error before deciding no result write
checks.required_simulation: fn4/7 with outstanding pipeline data; no destination write, then successful reuse

checks.static_result: normal service response appears only after destination write response is accepted; write request acceptance alone is insufficient
checks.required_simulation: stall write request and real write ACK; rsp must remain absent until ACK retired

checks.static_result: RESPONSE holds error/saturation, refuses new request; caller retains S owner until rsp handshake; no standalone arbitration or caller lease hardware exists inside adapter
checks.required_simulation: rsp_ready=0 hold and req field mutation; caller owner invariant

checks.static_result: read/write/native input payload is captured state and changes only after relevant handshake; G input selection changes with accepted issued index
checks.required_simulation: independent finite stalls on each request/native/service interface

checks.static_result: reset masks valid/ready and clears state/count/flags, but adapter-only reset cannot classify old native or helper outputs; caller must reset native, helper and lease coherently
checks.required_simulation: coordinated reset during gather/native flight/write ACK and successful next service

checks.static_result: local validation/read/native errors precede any destination write; WRITE_RSP error follows an accepted destination write and cannot undo it; current real S helper reports no error
checks.required_simulation: if synthetic mem_rsp_error is injected, distinguish read-error no-write from write-ACK error with already-written data

caller_obligations: exclusive ordinary-S owner from service admission until response consumption
no source mutation by another master during sequential gathers; in-place destination alias is safe only after all operands captured
coordinated adapter/native/helper reset; no standalone no-reset cancel or stale-response epoch isolation
interpret rsp_error as failure, not proof destination remained unchanged
bind logical tensor scale/layout separately; these adapters do not infer a universal Q format

advisories.text: Do not say any error means no result write. Native/validation/read error and destination ACK error have different side-effect boundaries; current helper rsp_error is constant0.

Root FFN-r02 passed and exact source hashes were read back; evidence covers E0/E7 count8, G0 gated count8 and named fault/lifecycle cases only. Standalone E/G suite and all-operation numerical claims remain pending.
